podcast.title: The Police Reunion Tour Support (2007)
podcast.body: Fiction Plane served as an opening act for some dates on The Police's reunion tour in 2007. "but also opened some dates for the police's reunion tour in 2007."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: ViClone Software Company Founder (2010)
podcast.body: In 2010, Joe and a friend co-founded ViClone, a company that developed an app to stitch together multiple fan-shot videos into a single movie with different camera angles, though the app ceased to exist by 2016. "He and a friend founded a company called ViClone, which stitched together multiple fan shot videos into one movie featuring shots from different angles."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: City of Angels FC Founder
podcast.body: Currently, Joe is the founder of City of Angels FC, a soccer team based in Los Angeles. "His current thing is working as the founder of an LA-based soccer team called City of Angels FC."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Musical Style Comparison
podcast.body: The transcript prompts listeners to consider if there is any discernible Police influence in Fiction Plane's music. "You hear any police influence in this?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Nirvana's "Nevermind" Inspiration
podcast.body: His passion for writing songs was ignited by hearing Nirvana's album "Nevermind" for the first time, rather than his father's music, despite having learned some guitar and drums. "It was hearing Nirvana's Never Mind for the first time. He'd already learned a little guitar and drums, but it was that record that inspired him to start writing songs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Son of Sting and Frances Tomelty
podcast.body: Joe Sumner is the son of Gordon Sumner (Sting) and actress Frances Tomelty from Northern Ireland. His parents divorced in 1984. "His mom is Francis Tomlty, an actress from Northern Ireland. She and Sting were once married, but they divorced in 1984."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
